$comment: Every directory under packages/ is declared here, with the checks it runs in CI. This file is executable, not descriptive: bin/run-checks.mjs runs a check across the packages that declare it, so a package listed here as checked really is checked, and one that is not says why. bin/verify-packages.mjs keeps it honest against what is on disk. Order is the order checks run in.

cpro.reason: C/C++ and WebAssembly learning sources with no package.json; use the native tools described in its README, not the JavaScript workspace.

image-process.reason: Native C image-processing experiment with CMake, Make and Conan configuration; no package.json or JavaScript entry point.

precss.reason: CSS sources with no package.json; nothing in the JavaScript toolchain applies.

rust.reason: Rust sources with no package.json; built and tested by cargo, not by this workspace.
